rules: Exact Canvas child before Host authorization; only default non-frame build with no affected objects or conflict decision. No caller transaction or operation facts.

Workshop supplies its own coherent durable current confirmed turn, exact parent, immutable compiled operations and Canvas analysis/inspection, after authenticating Host. Renderer and model cannot supply these facts.

Provider-only live facts, not wire authentication. Host captures exact invocation and authenticated service instances outside JSON, reads its original issuance and verifies original game grant now; Workshop resolves its durable current turn. UNKNOWN/expired/revoked grants fail closed. Recheck immediately before Canvas dispatch and after async work; never cache this context as authorization.

authoritySemantics.scope: Only the current confirmed default AdvanceCurrentBuild -> ApplyRecoverableCommit with no affected objects, no conflict decision and RECOVERABLE_VERIFIED. This is a pure contract, not a new server, issuer or permission source. The public request remains narrow; only Workshop owns turn/transaction/operations/confirmation identity.
authoritySemantics.facts: Workshop durably records the exact AdvanceCurrentBuild parent, confirmationInputId, current turnRef/revision, intent, compiled operations and Canvas analysis before issue. It forms the exact Apply child payload using its existing transaction and inspection. Child requestId is parent.requestId + :apply. An unknown parent/confirmation/analysis, wrong stage, affected object or changed durable fact refuses issue; no guessed frame, invented ID, fake image or hand-written digest.
authoritySemantics.host: Host independently authenticates the active invocation, exact live Session incarnation, Workshop and Canvas service instances; captures exact parent and outgoing child outside renderer/model JSON; reads original durable OriginalSessionBinding; uses Adapter VerifyCurrentGrant for the exact original grant, epoch, player, world and actions; obtains VerifiedBinding from the authenticated engine/transport verifier. VerifiedBinding.authorizerRef is that real engine authorizer, not hostIssuerRef. All common binding fields and action scopes must match exactly and include APPLY_RECOVERABLE. Missing/unavailable verification is UNKNOWN and denies. Host also authenticates the Workshop snapshot and rechecks currentness at use. JSON status/ref equality or a digest never authenticates these sources.
authoritySemantics.digest: D(current-build-action, CurrentBuildActionProjection) uses the declared separate domain and complete projection, including exact parent/child, original grant/incarnation, confirmed intent/turn, analysis/operations/inspection and service instances. For this authenticated default operation only, AuthProjection.surfaceActionDigest carries this current-build-action digest. The field is an action-identity commitment; it must be resolved against the Host-issued durable action record with its declared kind. For actual InvokeAction, surface-action and ActionProjection still mean a real current frame. Never hash non-frame facts as surface-action, fabricate frame/action IDs, or accept either kind merely because its value is 64 hex characters.
authoritySemantics.issuance: deriveCurrentBuildAuthorization only produces a strictly typed candidate after coherence checks. Host must atomically durably reserve the exact candidate against Session/incarnation + parent requestId before releasing its AuthProjection; conflicting races deny. Consumers only accept that Host-issued exact record, never a renderer/model-derived candidate. validateCurrentBuildAuthorizedApply re-derives against fresh trusted context and checks the actual entire Canvas child plus exact issued record before dispatch. Authentication/revocation also remains enforced by Canvas/Adapter at their write barrier.
authoritySemantics.replay: NEW requires no prior durable issuance. EXACT_REPLAY requires the identical stored CurrentBuildAuthorization including original child transaction/operations/service instances and all hashes, and all live checks again; a missing or changed record, CONFLICT, expired/revoked/regranted grant or replaced Session denies. Completed calls return their existing durable receipt without creating or issuing a fresh transaction. Pending Canvas recovery remains its existing exact durable-request/query path. No replay refreshes IDs, changes the child or expands rights.
authoritySemantics.currentness: Cancellation/end/replaced Session or service, superseded/unconfirmed turn, changed confirmation/intent/operations/analysis, stale world/selection revisions, wrong actor/world/parent/child and unknown fields reject before world calls. Workshop and Host serialize durable snapshot/issuance or use equivalent CAS; they recheck after awaits and immediately at child dispatch. Canvas owns final revision/region/object/conflict checks and all transaction decisions; contracts never chooses or writes the world.
authoritySemantics.capability: All participants in this new path require exactly hanaworlds-contracts@0.3.9 via checkCurrentBuildAuthorizationHandshake. No old-peer/profile adaptation or migration.

AdvanceCurrentBuild.authorizationSemantics: Default non-frame Apply follows CURRENT_BUILD_AUTHORIZATION_EXTENSION: Workshop-owned durable current facts, Host-authenticated exact original grant/invocation/child/services, separate current-build-action digest. Conflicting replay or changed digest is returned honestly with no new transaction.
